text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—They pass the 400m mark!
Out of the fourth corner and into the home stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Now's the time!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAARGH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Bubble Gum Fellow!!
Bubble Gum Fellow takes the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow crosses the finish line in first place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"So strong~! Seriously incredible speed!
Bubble Gum Fellow, you're definitely going places in the Classics!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
…………Running like this in a GⅠ.
I knew you were special too, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That is precisely why—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Yeah, that response was the absolute best...! Now I understand completely—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(My strongest distance is from mile to medium...!
I'm certain of it...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Then the race I must run from here on is—)

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
She did it, she did it—!!
Bubble-chan won!! That's amazing!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: Ah...! As expected of you, Bubble...!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: ......Congratulations, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Lapis. Cure. We can't let ourselves lose either.
The 'Hopeful Stakes'...
Let's show them what we're capable of."

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
We, the 'Four Heavenly Kings', will sweep year-end!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Let's sweep the podium, one-two-three!
Ah, but first place is mine, okay~!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Congratulations to you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
This glory is something we seized together, just the two of us.
...Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the Asahi Hai FS concluded with a brilliant victory for Bubble Gum Fellow—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The next day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During a meeting to discuss his Classic Year rotation, Bubble Gum Fellow shared what he felt from the Asahi Hai FS—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I'm more certain than ever now.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I was told that mile to medium-distance races are where I can unleash my true strength the most.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...That's precisely why we have to decide, right?
choice_data_list: ...The question is what to do about the Classic Triple Crown, huh.
...The question is what we should do about the Classic Triple Crown, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The royal road of races that birthed countless legends,
the "Classic Triple Crown Route,"
is comprised of three prestigious races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The turf 2000m Satsuki Sho at Nakayama Racecourse.
The turf 2400m Japanese Derby at Tokyo Racecourse.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Held at Kyoto Racecourse, Turf 3000m.
The long-distance race that crowns the final leg of the Triple Crown: the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hypothetically, if Bubble Gum Fellow were to run in this race, it would inevitably be a tough battle in terms of distance suitability.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And this is something faced by every Umamusume with distance aptitudes
like Bubble Gum Fellow,
who ran in the Classic races in the past.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...If one only considers winning,
avoiding the Kikuka Sho due to aptitude
can be considered a rational decision."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, if you're trying to prove your strength,
that is another story entirely—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Racing history tells us:
there is a "strength" that can only be proven
by running the Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That would be the presence of the "Triple Crown Umamusume" who conquered all three Classic races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Their great achievement of dominating races from 2000m to 3000m, centered around the traditional 2400m distance. It will be etched into racing history forever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much time passes, they will always have a seat
whenever the 'strongest' is discussed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Only a hero who commands such awe
can be called a 'Triple Crown Umamusume'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, if one wishes to prove their strength,
they should run in all of the Classic Triple Crown races.
It is a fact that such a viewpoint exists.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If Bubble Gum Fellow avoided the Kikuka Sho
due to distance aptitude, proving her strength
to the world would become much harder.
choice_data_list: (Provided, of course, that she merely dodged.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: There is one option. A prestigious race held at Tokyo Racecourse around the same time that would more than prove your strength without running the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rather than simply avoiding the Kikuka Sho... there is a grueling battlefield that only Bubble Gum Fellow can choose—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
No, sorry.
It's just a hunch, but...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I think you and I are picturing
the exact same race right now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"So, let me hear it. From your own lips, Trainer.
The name of the race we should challenge in our future."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The old me never would have been able to say it.
choice_data_list: ...Our goal isn't the Kikuka Sho, but—
...Our goal isn't the Kikuka Sho, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, as Bubble Gum Fellow's
Trainer now, I can make that difficult choice.
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
A 2000m turf medium-distance GⅠ race
held at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike the Classic Triple Crown where only Classic-year runners can compete,
this race is also open to Senior-year runners. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—She would have to compete against Senior Year
horse girls whose bodies, tactics, and experience
were far more polished than Classic Year runners.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And that means it's a stage to decide not just the strongest of a generation, but the strongest of an era...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I know. No Classic-class Umamusume has ever won the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Even Oguri-senpai, with her legendary achievements,
lost to Tamamo-senpai,
who was the strongest back then...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's why in the racing world, the notion that 'there is a gap in ability between Classic-class and Senior-class racers' is taken as common sense.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Still... that's exactly why...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —I want to win!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely because no one has won it yet,
it will be undeniable proof of strength to all who behold it...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I want to break through this impossibility...!
I want to win and prove that we are the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A fist thrust straight ahead.
The fiery heat radiating from it fuels my own feelings—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Bubble Gum Fellow and I decided
to forge ahead on a path no one had ever
traveled before—

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text: Not running in the Kikuka Sho...?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've decided to set my sights on
the Tenno Sho (Autumn) for my Classic year's autumn!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, properly participating in the spring Satsuki Sho
and getting results is the top priority for now.
That's just a long-term goal, though."

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, wha~t...?
I-Is that even allowed...?!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, it's not out of the question.
Last year, a Classic-class Umamusume took up the challenge
and fought hard for 2nd place. However—"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
No Classic-class Umamusume has ever won before.
...And that's precisely why Bubble is taking on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Exactly! You guys have the Kikuka Sho, and I have the Tenno Sho (Autumn). If we both win our races—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: A true era-shaking Four Heavenly Kings whirlwind! Right? Come on, let's all aim for that together!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
Th-That is so true~~!
Wait, that's seriously amazing!
We totally, totally gotta do it!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: Just for today, I agree with Lapis. If this happens, it'll create an unmatched Four Heavenly Kings whirlwind...!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even though we haven't even
run in the Hopeful Stakes yet—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Still... Bubble is right.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it, all of us together.
We'll make next year the year of the Heavenly Kings!!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with all the members of the Big Four,
we reaffirmed the paths we would take in the Classic year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer,
got a minute?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Sorry this is so sudden! But about what's ahead...
would it be all right if I took a break
from racing for a while...?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I've been feeling pretty heavily fatigued for some reason.
...I was totally fine after running in the
Asahi Hai FS, though."
choice_data_list: Got it, let's take it easy for the rest of the year

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai FS was Bubble Gum Fellow's
first GⅠ and a grueling race.
The aftereffects might still be lingering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is still time before the Satsuki Sho.
It's best to tread carefully and avoid racing for the rest of the year.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks!
I'll go ahead and do what I can too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Yes, if we stay cautious like this until
next year's Satsuki Sho, we'll surely be fine.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's what I had thought————
